bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$root"
git fetch -q origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111
head=4a2671cfc95acb758ee2bdd1cd6c2a01d505b91c
p=$(mktemp /tmp/userbot-keepalive-XXXX.py)
trap 'rm -f "$p"' EXIT
git show "$head:scripts/userbot_keepalive.py" > "$p"
python3 -B -c 'import ast,sys; t=open(sys.argv[1]).read(); ast.parse(t); assert "client.log_out" not in t and "sign_in" not in t and "send_code_request" not in t; assert "auto_reconnect=True" in t; print("USERBOT_KEEPALIVE_SYNTAX_PASS")' "$p"
secrets="$root/deploy/secrets"
if test -d "$secrets"; then echo SECRETS_DIR=EXISTS; else echo SECRETS_DIR=MISSING; fi
if test -f "$secrets/userbot_verify.session"; then echo SESSION_PRESENT=YES; else echo SESSION_PRESENT=NO; fi
if test -f "$secrets/userbot.env"; then echo AUTH_ENV_PRESENT=YES; echo AUTH_ENV_MODE=$(stat -c %a "$secrets/userbot.env"); else echo AUTH_ENV_PRESENT=NO; fi
python3 -c 'import importlib.util; print("TELETHON_INSTALLED="+str(importlib.util.find_spec("telethon") is not None))'
echo USERBOT_KEEPALIVE_PREFLIGHT_DONE
